angle: How to tell in four clicks whether a Meta campaign is optimising for buyers or for form-fillers. Exact path, no tools.
hook: Most people judge a campaign by the ad copy. The real answer is four clicks away in Ads Manager. Open Ads Manager. Click the campaign name, not the ad — that's click one.
body:
Most people judge a campaign by the ad copy. The real answer is four clicks away in Ads Manager.

Open Ads Manager. Click the campaign name, not the ad — that's click one.

Click the ad set sitting under it. That's click two. An ad set is the layer that holds your budget, your audience and your optimisation choice.

Scroll to the section called 'Optimization & delivery.' That's click three.

Read the line 'Performance goal.' Click four. It names the exact event Meta is optimising for — leads, messages, or purchases.

If you sell a product but the goal reads 'Leads,' Meta is finding you people who fill forms, not people who buy. Different skill, different audience, different result.

I check this before I
